body.statement: The constructed law \(P_{\mathrm{wit}}\) belongs to \(\mathcal M_{2,3}\), has unequal propensities, has maximizing arm \(a=1\) at \(x=1\) and maximizing arm \(a=3\) at \(x=2\), and satisfies \(V^\star(P_{\mathrm{wit}})=43/50\).
body.justification: The explicit law catches accidental assumptions of uniform logging or a common maximizing treatment across groups.
body.gap: This is an internal specification witness rather than a novelty claim; it tests the exact scope omitted by one-group and fixed-policy analyses.
body.consumer: Formalization and estimator definitions receive a concrete regression test with switching winners and legal unequal treatment probabilities.
